reconcile.note: Clarke locates the extra Cainan in Luke's genealogy in the Septuagint tradition Luke followed, while the Hebrew text behind Genesis has no such generation.

discrepancy.note: Strauss noted that Luke's genealogy inserts a second Cainan between Arphaxad and Salah found in neither Genesis 10:24 nor 11:12, but only in the Septuagint.

quotes.text: Also, in the series before Abraham, Luke inserts a Cainan, who is not to be found in the Hebrew text, Gen. x. 24 ; xi. 12 ff. , but who was however already inserted by the LXX.
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined, §21 (1846), on Genesis 10:24, 11:12 and Luke 3:36.

sides.snippet: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years, and became the father of Shelah.
sides.verseText: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years, and became the father of Shelah.
